ledger.x: 1940, 21 July: the Estonian SSR is "nominally established to replace the until then independent Republic of Estonia on 21 July 1940" after the Red Army occupation of 16-21 June; "formally annexed into the Soviet Union on 6 August 1940".
1941: "Estonia was occupied by Nazi Germany in 1941" and "administered as a part of Reichskommissariat Ostland".
1945: "the Petseri County was annexed and ceded to the Russian SFSR" and became a district of Pskov Oblast.
1945, January: "the Narva River was defined as the border between the Estonian SSR and Russian SFSR" and "administration of Ivangorod was transferred from Narva to the Leningrad Oblast".
1990, 8 May: "the Estonian Soviet Socialist Republic was renamed the Republic of Estonia" (on 30 March 1990 the new parliament declared that Estonia had been illegally occupied since 1940).
1991, 20 August: "the Estonian Parliament adopted a resolution confirming its independence from the Soviet Union"; the USSR State Council recognised it on 6 September 1991.

certainty.note: The extent of Petseri County and the Ivangorod strip is the researcher's circle; the pages give no areas.
Narva River and the Petseri line as fixed in 1945.
